feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. I accept your revert to the iteration 7 geometry, and I keep the iteration 7 controller unchanged so this race reproduces the best known result. Evidence: iteration 7 (50 mm, 12 mm, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.10) scored 399.7 with oval progress 0.995. Iteration 8 (60 mm) fell to oval progress 0.301, as did iteration 3 (60 mm), so 60 mm is rejected. Bend max_error has stayed at 0.059 to 0.068 m across every span, footprint, lead, speed and wheel_track change, so it is not explained by sensing geometry alone. Decide from the next race as follows. If oval progress is at or above 0.95 and s-bend steering oscillation is at or below 0.3, the controller is stable on this base, and I will test a lead change. If s-bend steering oscillation stays above 0.3, I will lower kp or kd on the controller, not the geometry. If bend max_error stays on its plateau with the controller stable, you may test the lead change you asked about.
requested_changes: Yes to your y 0.04 lead test on the bend tracks, with no other change, only once the next race shows oval progress at or above 0.95 and bend max_error still on the 0.059 to 0.068 m plateau. Iteration 1 showed that y 0.03 collapses progress (0.273 at 60 mm), so do not go below 0.04.
Hold the 50 mm span with 12 mm footprints and wheel_track 0.10. Iteration 4 (50 mm) and iteration 7 (50 mm, wheel 0.10) both held oval progress above 0.7, while iteration 8 (60 mm) fell to 0.301.

A 16 mm footprint at 50 mm span is untested at wheel_track 0.10. Propose it only if the lead test does not move bend max_error, because iteration 2 (16 mm, 60 mm span) showed that footprint size alone is not the limit.
